verdict.rationale: Secureframe is a SaaS compliance platform, so letting users opt out of telemetry or product-usage analytics is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. Related controls, such as hiding Trust Center content or OAuth token handling for the MCP server, are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
